name: daftcss
description: A semantic-first CSS framework with shadcn/ui-quality aesthetics

scripts.build: lightningcss --bundle src/daft.css -o dist/daft.css && lightningcss --bundle --minify src/daft.css -o dist/daft.min.css && cp dist/daft.css dist/daft.min.css docs/dist/
scripts.check: npm run check:build && npm run check:docs && npm run check:skill
scripts.test: npm run test:browser && npm run test:a11y
